name: portrait_hall
description: a painting of augustus blackwood in his prime. his cold, calculating eyes follow you around the room. the nameplate reads: 'augustus blackwood, 1835-1891, patriarch of blackwood manor.' there's a crack in the canvas — deliberate, not from age.

params.success_message: you touch the crack in the canvas. behind the painting, taped to the back, you find a small photograph. it shows augustus with a woman who is not his wife — the same woman from the love letters in the library. they're holding hands. on the back: 'my dearest margaret. someday we'll be free.'
